subject.title: fix(ai): add handshake timeout to ChatGPT Responses WebSocket connect

question: Should an explicit request timeout longer than 30 seconds remain authoritative for the ChatGPT Responses WebSocket handshake, or should the provider impose a documented 30-second maximum regardless of that request budget?
rationale: The branch establishes a new relationship between a provider-level safety cap and an existing caller-controlled request budget; source evidence does not establish which timeout is the intended product contract.

options.title: Honor the explicit request budget
options.body: Use the default 30-second deadline only when no request budget is supplied, while preserving an explicit caller timeout for the connection attempt.

options.title: Adopt a hard 30-second provider cap
options.body: Keep the 30-second maximum only with explicit maintainer approval, documentation of the override semantics, and coverage for callers requesting longer budgets.

recommendation.title: Honor the explicit request budget
recommendation.body: Use the default 30-second deadline only when no request budget is supplied, while preserving an explicit caller timeout for the connection attempt.
